# Transvoxel Tables

Source: https://github.com/EricLengyel/Transvoxel

Fetched from commit:

```text
51a494f Add files via upload
```

The repository is linked from https://transvoxel.org/ as the official data
tables for the Transvoxel Algorithm. The copied files are kept as third-party
reference material only; they are not wired into the runtime yet.
